OrganizationSwitcher.title: Switch workspace
OrganizationSwitcher.pickDescription: Your account belongs to multiple organizations. Select one to continue.

Dashboard.title: Control Center
Dashboard.description: Welcome to your organization's control center.
Dashboard.activityDescription: Latest audit events in this organization.

CommandPalette.title: Command palette
CommandPalette.description: Jump to a page or run an action
CommandPalette.empty: No results. Type a command name (e.g. Roles), not a URL.

BillingCustomers.title: Customers
BillingCustomers.description: People and companies you sell to.
BillingCustomers.formDescription: Master data used on quotes and invoices.
BillingCustomers.empty: No customers yet. Add your first customer to get started.
BillingCustomers.deleteConfirm: Delete customer {name}? It will be hidden from lists; the record is kept for audit.

BillingSuppliers.title: Suppliers
BillingSuppliers.description: Vendors you buy from or receive e-invoices from.
BillingSuppliers.formDescription: Master data for purchasing and inbound documents.
BillingSuppliers.empty: No suppliers yet. Add your first supplier to get started.
BillingSuppliers.deleteConfirm: Delete supplier {name}? It will be hidden from lists; the record is kept for audit.

BillingItems.title: Catalog
BillingItems.description: Products and services with price hints (no stock).
BillingItems.formDescription: Lightweight catalog for invoice line items.
BillingItems.empty: No catalog items yet. Add a product or service.
BillingItems.viewDescription: Catalog data used on invoice lines.
BillingItems.deleteConfirm: Delete item {name}? It will be hidden from the catalog; the record is kept for audit.

BillingInbound.title: Purchase invoices
BillingInbound.description: Supplier e-invoices: register purchases and accept/reject with Hacienda (mock by default).
BillingInbound.uploadDescription: Paste a signed FE XML. Supplier is auto-matched by tax id when possible.
BillingInbound.empty: No inbound documents yet. Upload a supplier FE XML to start.
BillingInbound.viewDescription: Received supplier e-document and Hacienda respuesta.
BillingInbound.rejectDescription: MensajeReceptor rejection requires a short reason.

BillingInvoices.title: Sales invoices
BillingInvoices.description: What you issue and collect (cash/credit), with PDF and Hacienda emit.
BillingInvoices.viewDescription: Document-style view: header, lines, totals, and payments.
BillingInvoices.formDescription: Draft invoices can be edited until issued.
BillingInvoices.haciendaDetailDescription: Official Ministerio de Hacienda text for this voucher.
BillingInvoices.empty: No invoices yet. Create a draft to get started.
BillingInvoices.emailDialogDescription: Leave blank to use the customer email on file.
BillingInvoices.emailsEmpty: This invoice has not been emailed yet.
BillingInvoices.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft invoice? It will be hidden from lists; the record is kept for audit.
BillingInvoices.voidConfirm: Void this issued invoice? The document stays for audit but can no longer be paid or emailed.

SettingsLayout.title: Settings
SettingsLayout.description: Manage your account, preferences, and workspace.

SettingsFiscal.title: Fiscal & Hacienda
SettingsFiscal.description: Issuer identity for e-invoicing and encrypted Hacienda credentials. Live submit is Phase B6.
SettingsFiscal.profileDescription: Issuer identity and fiscal domicile (as in Hacienda).
SettingsFiscal.profileRequired: Name and identification number are required.
SettingsFiscal.credentialsDescription: Encrypted .p12 and API secrets. Not shown again after save (eye = preview before save).
SettingsFiscal.credentialsConfigured: Credentials on file ({environment}). Upload again only to replace.
SettingsFiscal.clearDialogDescription: Remove stored certificate and secrets for this organization. You can upload them again later.

SettingsAudit.title: Audit log
SettingsAudit.description: Recent security and administration events for this organization.

SettingsProfile.title: General Profile
SettingsProfile.description: Update your personal information and system preferences.
SettingsProfile.successMessage: Your profile has been updated successfully.
SettingsProfile.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 2MB.

SettingsSecurity.title: Security
SettingsSecurity.description: Ensure you are using a long, secure password.
SettingsSecurity.successMessage: Your password has been updated successfully.

SettingsOrg.title: Organization Settings
SettingsOrg.description: Manage the public name and identifier of your workspace.
SettingsOrg.orgSlugDescription: Unique identifier used in URLs (e.g., my-company).
SettingsOrg.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 2MB.
SettingsOrg.dangerZoneDescription: Permanently soft-delete this organization and revoke access for all members.
SettingsOrg.deleteDialogDescription: This will soft-delete {name}. Members will lose access immediately.

SettingsMembers.description: Manage who has access to this organization and their permission levels.

SettingsMembers.noMembersFound: No members found in this organization.
SettingsMembers.pendingDescription: People invited who have not joined yet.
SettingsMembers.revokeConfirm: Revoke this invitation? The recipient will no longer be able to join with this link.

SettingsRoles.title: Roles & Permissions
SettingsRoles.description: Manage custom roles and their permission scopes for this workspace.

SettingsRoles.deleteConfirm: Delete the role "{name}"? It will be hidden; the change is recorded in audit.

Invitations.inviteDescription: Send an email invitation to add a new member to your workspace.

InviteAccept.title: Join the Organization
